title: Hannun jari, riba da littafin aiki guda don duk kasuwancin ku
course_title: Excel da Google Sheets don Ƙananan Kasuwanci

say: Hannun jari, riba, da littafin aiki guda don duk kasuwancin ku.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 4 na Excel da Google Sheets don Ƙananan Kasuwanci.

Hannun jari galibi shine mafi girman adadin kuɗin da ƙaramin ɗan kasuwa ya ɗaure. Takaddun ƙira yana gaya muku abin da kuke da shi, abin da yake da daraja, da abin da za ku sake yin oda kafin abokan ciniki su sami rumfuna mara komai.

panel.heading: Hada duka tare
items: Sanin abin hannun jari da kuke riƙe da abin da za ku sake yin oda
Nemo farashi ta lambar samfur
Gano idan da gaske kun sami riba
Aikin yau da kullun wanda ke kiyaye lambobin gaskiya

say: Hakanan yana ciyar da farashi a cikin log ɗin tallace-tallace na ku, don haka ku daina buga su da hannu.

say: Sannan rahoton riba ya amsa tambayar kowane abokin tarayya ko mai ba da bashi ya yi. Shin da gaske kasuwancin ya sami kuɗi a wannan watan?

say: A shafin Samfura, ba kowane samfur gajeriyar lamba ta musamman, kamar P01, sannan sunansa, farashin farashi da farashin siyarwa.

panel.heading: Hannun jari wanda ke gaya muku lokacin sake yin oda
items: Code, samfur, farashin farashi, farashin siyarwa
Hannun buɗewa, hannun jari a ciki, sayarwa
Rufe hannun jari: = E2+F2-G2
Matsayi: =IF(H2=I2,Sake oda","OK")
Ƙimar hannun jari a farashi: = H2*C2

say: Sa'an nan kuma buga hannun jari na budewa, hannun jari da kuka saya, da raka'o'in da aka sayar.

say: Ƙimar hannun jari tana rufe farashin farashin lokutan hannun jari.
Misali, Funke tana da kayan wanke-wanke guda 6 da suka rage, kuma matakin sake yin odar ta shine 8, don haka ya ce Reorder. Hajarta a hannunta ya kai naira 80250 akan farashi.

panel.rule: Rufe hannun jari = buɗe hannun jari + hannun jari a cikin raka'a da aka siyar

say: A shafin tallace-tallace na ku, rubuta lambar samfur kawai, kuma bari bincike ya ɗauki farashin. XLOOKUP yana nemo lambar a cikin ginshiƙin Code kuma ya dawo da farashin siyarwa daga jere ɗaya. Idan lambar ta kasance P03, tana dawowa 3300.

panel.heading: Dauki farashin daga lambar
left: Za a iya cewa Ba a samo ba
right: Yana aiki a cikin tsohuwar Excel kuma

say: Idan Excel ɗinku ya kasance 2019 ko fiye, yi amfani da VLOOKUP. Dole ne lambar ta kasance a cikin ginshiƙin farko na tebur.
Kuma ko da yaushe gama da KARYA. Barin shi na iya mayar da farashin samfurin da bai dace ba a hankali. Idan ka ga hash N A, ba a sami lambar ba. Duba harafin O da aka buga maimakon sifili.

panel.heading: Dauki farashin daga lambar

say: Yanzu riba. Talla shine kuɗin da ake samu daga siyarwa. Farashin kayan da aka sayar shine abin da haƙiƙan da kuka sayar ke kashe ku: buɗe ƙimar hannun jari, da siyayya, rage ƙimar hannun jari.
Me yasa ba a rage siyayya ba? Domin idan ka tara kaya da yawa, watan yana kama da asara duk da cewa har yanzu kayan suna kan rumbunka.

panel.heading: Daga tallace-tallace zuwa ribar net
items: Sales: kudin da aka samu daga sayarwa
Farashin kayan sayarwa: menene farashin kayan da aka sayar
Babban riba: tallace-tallace ya rage farashin kaya
Riba ta yanar gizo: babbar riba ban da tsadar aiki
Margin: riba da aka raba ta tallace-tallace

say: Babban riba tallace-tallace ne rage farashin kaya. Riba ta yanar gizo tana kawar da tsadar gudu kuma, kamar haya, sufuri, bayanai da wuta.

say: Ga watan Oktoba na Funke. Ta buɗe da haja mai darajar 95000, ta sayi ƙarin 310000, ta rufe da 80250.
Sayar da ta ya kai Naira 412000. Don haka farashin kayanta ya kai 324750.
Babban riba shine 87250, jimlar riba ta 21.2%.
Raba hayar, sufuri, bayanan waya da wuta sun zo 50000.
Ribar da aka samu Naira 37250. A cikin kowane Naira 100 na tallace-tallace, kimanin Naira 9 ne ribar net. Hakan ya haura 6250 a watan Satumba.
Kudin gudanar da aiki kamar haya da sufuri suna cikin kuɗin aiki.

panel.heading: Zane-zane ba kuɗi ba ne
right: Kuɗin da kuke ɗauka don gidan ku

say: Amma kuɗaɗen da kuke fitar wa kanku ko gidan ku ba kuɗin kasuwanci bane. Yi rikodin shi azaman Zane kuma bar shi. In ba haka ba, rahoton ya ɓoye adadin kuɗin da kasuwancin ke samu, da kuma ko zai iya biyan ku.

panel.heading: Zane-zane ba kuɗi ba ne
right: Kuɗin da kuke ɗauka don gidan ku

say: Saka duk shafukanku a cikin littafin aiki ɗaya, kuma ci gaba da sauƙi na yau da kullun.
Kullum, mintuna 5 zuwa 10, yi rikodin kowane siyarwa da kashe kuɗi. Mako-mako, gudanar da rajistan tantanin halitta, duba lissafin Sake yin oda kuma ku bi siyar da ba a biya ba.
Wata-wata, ƙididdige ɗakunan ajiyar ku, yi rahoton riba kuma zazzage madadin. A cikin kwata, ku dubi wata uku tare kuma ku yanke shawara ɗaya.

panel.heading: Rike lambobin amintacce
items: Kullum: rikodin kowane ma'amala
Mako-mako: duba cell, Sake tsara lissafin, tallace-tallace da ba a biya ba
Wata-wata: ƙidaya jari, rahoto, ajiya
Kwata-kwata: bita ginshiƙi, yanke shawara ɗaya

say: Lokacin da kuka raba, zaɓi mafi ƙarancin damar da ke aiki. Mai kallo zai iya dubawa kawai. Ba Edita kawai ga mutanen da suke buƙatar bugawa da gaske.
Aika mai ba da bashi ko abokin tarayya rahoton azaman PDF, ba sunan kowane abokin ciniki ba.

say: Idan mataimaki ya daina aiki tare da ku, cire hanyarsu a wannan rana.

panel.rule: Cire hanyar shiga rana ɗaya wani ya daina aiki tare da ku

say: Don tunawa. Rufe hannun jari yana buɗewa tare da rage siyarwa. Matsayin sake yin oda yana yin lissafin siyayyar ku. VLOOKUP yana buƙatar KARYA. Riba ta yanar gizo babbar riba ce ban da tsadar aiki. Kuma kiyaye zane-zane daga kudade.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Rufe hannun jari = buɗewa + ciki - sayarwa
IDAN akasin matakin sake oda yana yin lissafin siyayya
VLOOKUP yana buƙatar KARYA don daidai daidai
Riba na net = babban riba - farashi mai gudana
Ci gaba da zane-zane daga kudade

say: Yanzu gina takardar lissafin ku, sanya rahoton ribar ku ta farko ta wata-wata a matsayin PDF, kuma ku haɗa cikakken littafin aikinku tare da naku na yau da kullun.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan fayil ɗin ku
items: Gina takardar lissafin ku
Rahoton riba na farko na wata-wata
Haɗa littafin aikin ku na kasuwanci
